mechanism: Foscarnet causes electrolyte abnormalities (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia, hypokalemia) and can impair renal function, which may alter bisacodyl's efficacy and increase risk of electrolyte-dependent adverse effects including cardiac arrhythmias.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes closely and renal function; use bisacodyl cautiously or consider alternative laxatives in patients receiving foscarnet, particularly if electrolyte disturbances develop.
